text:
violet: Kickoff: need a launch post + battlecard aimed at procurement + platform buyers. Angle: predictable TCO, SLA controls, vendor risk reduction. Webinar goal: drive AE-qualified procurement meetings. Target date: 2024-07-08.
samir: Procurement cares about repeatable unit economics and vendor lock-in risk. Include a short ROI calc example in the battlecard.
grace: I'll draft the procurement-facing one-pager. It should have: headline stat, 3-pageproof bullets (cost, latency, fallback policy), short ROI calc, and two negotiation play prompts for AEs.
oliver: Demo idea: recorded 3-min clip showing p95 under failure/fallback scenario (region outage -> automatic fallback to compatible model variant). Use anonymized logs.
sasha-sdr: Routing rules: registrant -> if role contains "Procurement" or company_size >= 1000 -> AE_procurement_queue; else AE_sales or SDR. EU/reg flags as usual. Need post-webinar asset pack for AEs including negotiation prompts.
copy-bot: (upload) sample ROI calc template -> https://assets.redwood/roi_templates/procurement_small.xlsx
samir: For claims: avoid "x-times" language. Use percentages or relative language: "~50% lower steady-state unit cost in typical inference workloads". Always cite appendix.
grace: I'll add objection handlers focused on contract terms, data residency, and SLAs. Keep each handler one sentence + suggested AE ask.
copy-bot: sample HubSpot pseudo-rule snippet:
```
if role contains "Procurement" OR company_size >= 1000 -> assign AE_procurement_queue
else if role contains "Platform" OR lead_score >= 70 -> assign AE_technical_queue
else -> assign SDR_nurture
```
sasha-sdr: Post-webinar playbook: 1) AE outreach template (procurement-specific), 2) 2-slide appendix for legal + security teams, 3) checklist to request dedicated trial. I'll draft.
violet: Owners: grace = procurement battlecard + negotiation prompts; samir = ROI calc + appendix; oliver = recorded fallback demo + short clip; sasha-sdr = playbook + templates; design = visuals. Check-in 48h.
samir: I'll include a tiny method blurb for appendix (hardware baseline, seq dist, batching) and a link to infra CSV for verification.
grace: Draft uploaded: https://notion.redwood/marketing/procurement/battlecard/procure-draft. Ping legal for review after product verifies numbers.
violet: Keep tone procurement-forward: clear risk reduction + dollars. No infra jargon. Good work team. :white_check_mark:
